versions.changelog:
Auto Google Review Reply v1.0.0

- Initial release supporting full end-to-end merchant onboarding.
- Enables login/registration, Google Business Profile connection, and 5-day automatic free trial (no upfront payment).
- Assists merchants in configuring AI-powered auto-reply features.
- Handles membership/trial status checks and provides clear guidance at each setup step.
- Uses secure token storage and supports both browser automation and SSO handoff login flows.
